Ek shakhs ne Aap se yahi masla pucha ke main apni aurat ko apne upar haram kar chuka hoon, toh Aap ne farmaya: Woh tujh par haram nahi, sab se zyada sakht kaffara is ka toh rah-e-Khuda ghulam azad karna hai. 
Imam Ahmad aur bahut se fuqaha ka fatwa hai ke jo shakhs apni biwi, laundi ya kisi khane peene pehanne odhne ki cheez ko apne upar haram kar le, toh us par kaffara wajib ho jata hai. 
Imam Shafi'i waghera farmate hain: Sirf biwi aur laundi ke haram karne par kaffara hai kisi aur par nahi, aur agar haram kehne se niyat talaq ki rakhi toh beshak talaq ho jayegi. Isi tarah laundi ke baare mein agar azadgi ki niyat haram ka lafz kehne se rakhi hai toh woh azad ho jayegi.

(2) Ibn Abbas se marwi hai yeh ayat us aurat ke baab mein nazil hui hai jis ne apna nafs An-Hazrat (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ko hiba kiya tha, lekin yeh ghareeb hai, bilkul sahi baat yeh hai ki in ayon ka utarna Aap ke shehad haram kar lene par tha. 
(3) Sahih Bukhari mein is ayat ke mauqa par ki Hazrat Zainab bint Jahsh (Razi Allahu Anha / R.A) ke ghar Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) shehad peete the aur us ki khatir zara si dair wahan theherte bhi the us par Hazrat Aisha aur Hazrat Hafsa ne aapas mein mashwara kiya ki hum mein se jis ke haan Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) aayein woh kahe ki Ya Rasool Allah ke aaj toh aap ke munh se gond ki si badboo aati hai shayad aap ne Maghafeir khaya hoga, chunancha hum ne yahi kiya, Aap ne farmaya nahi main ne toh Zainab ke ghar shehad piya hai ab qasam khata hoon ki na piyunga, yeh kisi se kehna mat. Imam Bukhari is hadis ko Kitab-ul-Aiman wal-Nazr mein bhi kuch ziyadati ke sath laye hain jis mein hai ki dono aurton se yahan murad Aisha aur Hafsa hain (Razi Allahu Anhum / R.A) aur chupke se baat kehna yahi tha ki main ne shehad piya hai, Kitab-ut-Talaq mein Imam Sahib (Rahimahullah / R.H) is hadis ko laye hain. 
Phir farmaya hai Maghafeir gond ke mushabah ek cheez hai jo shor ghaas mein paida hoti hai is mein qadray mithaas hoti hai. Sahih Bukhari Sharif ki Kitab-ut-Talaq mein yeh hadis Hazrat Aisha se in alfaaz mein marwi hai ki Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ko mithaas aur shehad bohat pasand tha, Asr ki namaz ke baad apni biwiyon ke ghar aate aur kisi se nazdeeki karte, ek martaba Aap Hazrat Hafsa ke ghar gaye aur jitna wahan rukte the us se ziyada ruke, mujhe ghairat sawar hui, tehqeeq ki toh maloom hua ki un ki kaum ki ek aurat ne ek kapi shehad ki unhein ba-taur hadiya ke bheji hai, unhon ne Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ko shehad ka sharbat pilaya aur itni dair rok rakha. Main ne kaha khair isay kisi heele se taal doongi, chunancha main ne Hazrat Sawda bint Zam'ah se kaha ki tumhare paas jab Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) aayein aur qareeb hon toh tum kehna ki aaj kya aap ne Maghafeir khaya hai? Aap farmayein ge nahi, tum kehna phir yeh badboo kaisi aati hai?

Aap farmayeinge mujhe Hafsah ne shahad pilaya tha toh tum kehna ke shayad shahad ki makhi ne Urfat naami khar-dar darakht chusa hoga, mere paas aayeinge main bhi yehi kahunga, phir hey Safiya tumhare paas jab aayein toh tum bhi yehi kehna, Hazrat Sawda farmati hain jab Huzoor ﷺ mere ghar aaye abhi toh darwaze hi par thay jo maine irada kiya ke tum ne jo mujh se kaha main aap se keh dun kyunke main tum se bohot darti thi lekin khair us waqt toh khamosh rahi jab aap mere paas aaye maine tumhara tamam kehna pura kar diya, phir Hazrat ﷺ mere paas aaye maine bhi yehi kaha phir Hazrat Safiya ke paas gaye unhon ne bhi yehi kaha phir jab Hazrat Hafsah ke paas gaye toh Hazrat Hafsah ne shahad ka sharbat pilana chaha aap ne farmaya mujhe is ki haajat nahi, Hazrat Sawda farmane lagein afsos hum ne ise haram kara diya maine kaha khamosh raho, Sahih Muslim ki is hadis mein itni ziyadti aur hai ke Nabi ﷺ ko badbu se sakht nafrat thi isi liye in biwiyon ne kaha tha ke aap ne Maghafeer khaya hai is mein bhi qadray badbu hoti hai, jab aap ne jawab diya ke nahi maine toh shahad piya hai toh unhon ne keh diya ke phir is shahad ki makhi ne Urfat darakht ko chusa hoga jis ke gond ka naam Maghafeer hai aur is ke asar se is shahad mein is ki bu reh gayi hogi, is riwayat mein lafz jarast hai jis ke ma'ani jauhari ne kiye hain khaya aur shahad ki makhiyon ko bhi jo Ras kehte hain aur Jaras madham halki aawaz ko kehte hain, Arab kehte hain jabke parinda daana chag raha ho aur us ki chonch ki aawaz sunai deti ho, aik hadis mein hai phir woh Jannati parindon ki halki aur meethi suhani aawazein suneinge, yahan bhi arabi mein lafz Jaras hai, Asma'i kehte hain main Hazrat Shuba ki majlis mein tha wahan unhon ne is lafz Jaras ko Jarash bari sheen ke sath parha maine kaha chote seen se hai Hazrat Shuba ne meri taraf dekha aur farmaya yeh hum se zyada ise jaante hain yehi theek hai tum islaah karlo, Al-garz shahad noshi ke waqia mein shahad pilane waliyon mein do naam marwi hain aik Hazrat Hafsah ka dusra Hazrat Zainab ka balkeh is amr par ittefaq karne waliyon mein Hazrat Aisha ke sath Hazrat Hafsah ka naam hai pas mumkin hai yeh woh waqia hon, yahan tak toh theek hai lekin in dono ke bare mein is ayat ka nazil hona zara ghor talab hai Wallahu A'lam, aapas mein is qisam ka mashwara karne wali Hazrat Aisha aur Hazrat Hafsah thin yeh is hadis se bhi maloom hota hai jo Musnad Imam Ahmad mein Hazrat Ibn Abbas ؓ se marwi hai farmate hain mujhe muddaton se aarzu thi ke Hazrat Umar se Huzoor ﷺ ki in dono biwi sahaban ka naam maloom karun jin ka zikr ayat In tatuba al-kh, mein hai pas hajj ke safar mein jab Khalifa-tul-Rasul chale toh main bhi hum-rakab ho liya aik raste mein Hazrat Umar rasta chod jangal ki taraf chale main dolchi liye hue peechhe peechhe gaya aap haajat-e-zaroori se farigh ho kar aaye main ne pani dalwaya aur wuzu karaya, ab mauqa pa kar sawal kiya ke hey Amir-ul-Momineen jin ke bare mein yeh ayat hai woh dono kaun hain ?

Aap ne farmaya Ibn Abbas afsos, Hazrat Zuhri farmate hain Hazrat Umar ko un ka yeh daryaft karna bura maloom hua lekin chupana jaiz na tha is liye jawab diya is se murad Hazrat Aisha aur Hazrat Hafsa hain R.A phir Hazrat Umar ne waqia bayan karna shuru kiya ki hum Quraish to apni aurton ko apne zair-e-farman rakhte the lekin Madina aaye to hamari aurton ne bhi un ki dekha dekhi hum par ghalba hasil karna chaha. Main Madina Sharif ke balai hisse mein Hazrat Umayyah bin Zaid ke ghar mein tehra hua tha ek martaba main apni biwi par kuch naraz hua aur kuch kehne sunne laga to palat kar us ne mujhe jawab dene shuru kiye mujhe nihayat bura maloom hua ki yeh kya harkat hai ? Yeh nayi baat kaisi ? Us ne mera tajajub dekh kar kaha ki aap kis khyal mein hain ? Allah ki kasam Anhadrat ﷺ ki biwiyan bhi aap ko jawab deti hain aur ba'az martaba to din din bhar bol chal chhor deti hain ab main to ek dusri uljhan mein par gaya seedha apni beti Hafsa ke ghar gaya aur daryaft kiya ki kya yeh sach hai ki tum Huzoor ﷺ ko jawab deti ho aur kabhi kabhi sara sara din roothi rehti ho ? Jawab mila ki sach hai. Main ne kaha ki barbad huin aur nuqsan mein pari jis ne aisa kiya. Kya tum is se ghafil ho gayin ki Rasulullah ﷺ ke gusse ki wajah se aisi aurat par Allah naraz ho jaye aur woh kahin ki na rahe ? Khabardar ayenda se Huzoor ﷺ ko koi jawab na dena na aap se kuch talab karna jo mangna ho mujh se mang liya karo, Hazrat Aisha ko dekh kar tum un ki hirs na karna woh tum se achhi aur tum se bahut zyada Rasulullah ﷺ ki manzoor-e-nazar hain. Ab aur suno mera parosi ek Ansari tha us ne aur main ne bariyani muqarrar kar li thin ek din main Huzoor ﷺ ki khidmat mein guzaarta aur ek din woh, main apni baari wale din ki tamam hadeethein aayetein waghera unhe aa kar suna deta aur yeh baat hum mein us waqt mashhoor ho rahi thi ki Ghassani baadshah apne fauji ghoron ke naal lagwa raha hai aur is ka irada hum par charhai karne ka hai, ek martaba mere sathi apni baari wale din gaye hue the Isha ke waqt aa gaye aur mera darwaza khatkhata kar mujhe aawazein dene lage main ghabra kar bahar nikla daryaft kiya khariyat to hai ? Us ne kaha aaj to bara bhari kaam ho gaya main ne kaha kya Ghassani baadshah aa pohncha ? Us ne kaha is se bhi barh kar main ne pucha woh kya ? Kaha Rasulullah ﷺ ne apni biwi ko talaq de di main ne kaha afsos Hafsa barbad ho gayi aur us ne nuqsan uthaya mujhe pehle hi se is amr ka khatka tha subh ki namaz parhte hi kapre pehn kar main chala seedha Hafsa ke paas gaya dekha ki woh ro rahi hain main ne kaha kya Rasulullah ﷺ ne tumhein talaq de di ?

Jawab diya yeh toh kuch maloom nahi, aap hum se alag ho kar apne is bala khana mein tashreef farma hain main wahan gaya dekha ke ek habshi ghulam pehre par hai maine kaha jao mere liye ijazat talab karo woh gaya phir aa kar kehne laga Huzoor ﷺ ne kuch jawab nahi diya main wahan se wapas chala aaya masjid mein gaya dekha ke mimbar ke paas ek giroh sahaba ka baitha hua hai aur baaz baaz ke toh aansu nikal rahe hain, main thodi si der baitha lekin chain kahan phir uth khada hua aur wahan ja kar ghulam se kaha ke mere liye ijazat talab karo us ne phir aa kar yahi kaha ke kuch jawab nahi mila, main dobara masjid chala gaya phir wahan se ghabra kar nikla yahan aaya phir ghulam se kaha ghulam gaya aaya aur wahi jawab diya main wapas muda hi tha ke ghulam ne mujhe aawaz di ke aaiye aap ko ijazat mil gayi main gaya dekha ke Huzoor ﷺ ek bore par tek lagaye baithay huwe hain jis ke nishan aap ke jism-e-mubarak par zahir hain maine kaha ya Rasoolallah ﷺ kya aap ne apni biwiyon ko talaq de di hai ? Aap ne sar utha kar meri taraf dekha aur farmaya nahi, maine kaha Allahu Akbar ! Ya Rasoolallah ke baat yeh hai ke hum kaum-e-Quresh toh apni biwiyon ko apne dabao mein rakha karte the lekin Madine walon par un ki biwiyan ghalib hain yahan aa kar hamari aurton ne bhi un ki dekha dekhi yeh harkat shuru kardi, phir maine apni biwi ka waqia aur mera yeh khabar pa kar ke Huzoor ﷺ ki biwiyan bhi aisa karti hain yeh kehna ke kya unhein dar nahi ke Allah ke Rasool ﷺ ke ghusse ki wajah se Allah bhi un se naraz hojaye aur woh halak hojayein bayan kiya is par Huzoor ﷺ muskura diye. Maine phir apna Hafsa ke paas jana aur unhein Hazrat Ayesha ki rees karne se rokna bayan kiya is par dobara muskuraye maine kaha agar ijazat ho toh zara si der aur ruk jaun ? Aap ne ijazat di main baitha gaya ab jo sar utha kar charon taraf nazrein daudayein toh aap ki baithak (darbar-e-khas) mein siwaye teen khushk khalon ke aur koi cheez na dekhi, azruda dil ho kar arz kiya ke ya Rasoolallah ﷺ dua kijiye ke Allah Ta'ala aap ki ummat par kushadgi kare dekhiye toh Farsi aur Roomi jo Allah ki ibadat hi nahi karte unhein kis qadar duniya ki nematon mein wusat di gayi hai ? Yeh sunte hi aap sanbhal baithe aur farmane lage Aye Ibn-e-Khattab kya tu shak mein hai ?

Us kaum ki achhaiyan unhein ba-ujlat duniya mein hi de di gayin. Main ne kaha, "Ya Rasoolullah ﷺ! Mere liye Allah se maghfirat ki dua kijiye." Baat yeh thi ke aap ne sakht narazgi ki wajah se qasam kha li thi ke mahina bhar tak apni biwiyon ke paas na jaunga, yahan tak ke Allah Ta'ala ne aap ko tanbih ki. Yeh hadith Bukhari, Muslim, Tirmidhi aur Nasai mein bhi hai. 

Bukhari, Muslim ki hadith mein hai, Hazrat Ibn Abbas R.H farmate hain, saal bhar isi ummeed mein guzar gaya ke mauqa mile to Hazrat Umar R.A se un dono ke naam daryaft karun, lekin Haibat-e-Farooqi ki wajah se himmat nahi parti thi, yahan tak ke hajj ki wapsi mein pucha, phir poori hadith bayan ki jo opar guzar chuki hai. 

Sahih Muslim mein hai ke talaq ki shohrat ka waqia parde ki aayton ke nazil hone se pehle ka hai. Is mein yeh bhi hai ke Hazrat Umar R.A jis tarah Hazrat Hafsa R.A ke paas ja kar unhein samjha aaye the, usi tarah Hazrat Aisha R.A ke paas bhi ho aaye the. Aur yeh bhi hai ke us ghulam ka naam jo dyodi par pehra de rahe the, Hazrat Rabah R.H tha. Yeh bhi hai ke Hazrat Umar R.A ne Huzoor ﷺ se kaha, "Aap aurton ke baare mein is mashaqqat mein kyun parte hain? Agar aap unhein talaq bhi de dein to aap ke sath Allah Ta'ala, us ke farishte, Jibraeel, Mikaeel, aur main, aur Abu Bakr, aur jumla mominin hain." 

Hazrat Umar R.A farmate hain, "Alhamdulillah, main is qism ki jo baat kahta, mujhe ummeed lagi rehti ke Allah Ta'ala meri baat ki tasdiq nazil farmayega." Pas is mauqe par bhi Aayat-e-Takhbeer yani:
(عَسٰى رَبُّهٗٓ اِنْ طَلَّقَكُنَّ اَنْ يُّبْدِلَهٗٓ اَزْوَاجًا خَيْرًا مِّنْكُنَّ مُسْلِمٰتٍ مُّؤْمِنٰتٍ قٰنِتٰتٍ تٰۗىِٕبٰتٍ عٰبِدٰتٍ سٰۗىِٕحٰتٍ ثَيِّبٰتٍ وَّاَبْكَارًا) (66۔ التحریم: 5)
aur 
(وَاِنْ تَظٰهَرَا عَلَيْهِ فَاِنَّ اللّٰهَ هُوَ مَوْلٰىهُ وَجِبْرِيْلُ وَصَالِحُ الْمُؤْمِنِيْنَ ۚ وَالْمَلٰۗىِٕكَةُ بَعْدَ ذٰلِكَ ظَهِيْرٌ) (66۔ التحریم: 4)
aap par nazil huin. 

Mujhe jab aap ﷺ se maloom hua (aur) aap ne apni Azwaj-e-Mutahrat ko talaq nahi di hai, to main ne masjid mein aa kar darwaze par khada ho kar unchi aawaz se sab ko itlaa de di ke Huzoor ﷺ ne Azwaj-e-Mutahrat ko talaq nahi di hai. Isi ke baare mein Aayat-ul-Khauf aakhir tak utri yani jahan unhein koi aman ki ya khauf ki khabar pahunchi ke yeh use shohrat dene lagte hain, agar yeh is khabar ko Rasool ﷺ ya zi-aql-o-ilm musalmanon tak pohncha dete to beshak un mein se jo log muhaqqiq hain, woh ise samajh lete. 

Hazrat Umar R.A yahan tak is aayat ko parh kar farmate hain, "Pas is amr ka istanbat karne walon mein se main hi hun." Aur bhi bohat se buzurg mufassirin se marwi hai ke 'Salih-ul-Mumineen' se murad Hazrat Abu Bakr R.A aur Hazrat Umar R.A hain, baaz ne Hazrat Usman R.A ka naam bhi liya hai, baaz ne Hazrat Ali R.A ka.

Aik zaeef hadith mein marfoo'an sirf Hazrat Ali ka naam hai lekin sanad zaeef hai aur bilkul munkar hai, Sahih Bukhari Sharif mein hai ke aap ki biwiyan ghairat mein aagayin jis par maine un se kaha ke agar Huzoor ﷺ tumhein talaq de dein ge toh Allah Ta'ala tum se behtar biwiyan aap ko dega pas mere lafzon hi mein Quran ki yeh aayat utri, pehle yeh bayan ho chuka hai ke Hazrat Umar ﷺ ne bohat si baaton mein Quran ki muwafiqat ki jaise parde ke baare mein, badri qaidiyon ke baare mein, Maqam-e-Ibrahim ko qibla thehrane ke baare mein, Ibn Abi Hatim ki riwayat mein hai ke mujhe jab Umhat-ul-Momineen ki is ranjish ki khabar pohchi toh un ki khidmat mein gaya aur unhein bhi kehna shuru kiya yahan tak ke aakhri Umm-ul-Momineen ke paas pohcha toh mujhe jawab mila ke kya hamein Rasool Allah ﷺ khud nasehat karne ke liye kam hain jo tum aagaye? Is par main khamosh ho gaya lekin Quran mein aayat *'Asa Rabbuhu'*, al-ayah nazil hui, Sahih Bukhari mein hai ke jawab dene wali Umm-ul-Momineen Hazrat Umme Salma theen. Hazrat Ibn Abbas farmate hain jo baat Huzoor ﷺ ne chupke se apni biwi sahiba se kahi thi us ka waqia yeh hai ki aap Hazrat Hafsa ke ghar mein the woh tashreef layin aur Hazrat Maria se aap ko mashghool payaya toh aap ne unhein farmaya tum (Hazrat) Aisha ko khabar na karna main tumhein aik basharat sunata hoon mere inteqal ke baad meri khilafat (Hazrat) Abu Bakr ke baad tumhare walid ayenge. Hazrat Hafsa ne Hazrat Aisha ko khabar kardi pas Hazrat Aisha ne Rasool Allah ﷺ se kaha is ki khabar aap ko kis ne pohchayi? Aap ne farmaya mujhe Aleem-o-Khabeer Allah ne khabar pohchayi, Siddiqa ne kaha main aap ki taraf na dekhungi jab tak ke aap Maria ko apne oopar haram na kar lein aap ne haram kar li is par aayat *(Ya Ayyuhan-Nabiyyu lima tuharrimu ma ahallallahu laka tabtaghi mardata azwajika wallahu Ghafoorur Raheem)* (66. At-Tahrim: 1) nazil hui (Tabarani) lekin is ki sanad makhdosh hai, maqsad yeh hai ke in tamam riwayaat se in paak ayaton ki tafseer zahir ho gayi.

Tarjuma ki tafsir toh zahir hi hai, saihat ki tafsir ek toh yeh hai ke roza rakhne waliyan. Ek marfoo hadith mein bhi yahi tafsir is lafz ki aayi hai jo hadith Surah Bara'at ke is lafz ki tafsir mein guzar chuki hai ke is ummat ki siyahat roza rakhna hai. Dusri tafsir yeh hai ke murad is se hijrat karne waliyan hain, lekin awwal qaul hi awla hai, Wallahu A'lam. 

Phir farmaya un mein se baaz bewah hongi aur baaz kunwariyaan is liye ke ji khush rahe, qasmon ki tabdeeli nafs ko bhali maloom hoti hai.

Qatadah farmate hain Allah ki itaat ka unhe hukm do aur nafarmaniyon se rokte raho, un par Allah ke ahkaam qayam rakho aur unhe ahkaam-e-Allah baja lane ki taakid karte raho, naik kamon mein un ki madad karo aur bure kamon par unhe danto dapto. Zahhak-o-Muqatil farmate hain har Musalman par farz hai ke apne rishte-kunbe ke logon ko aur apne londi-ghulam ko Allah ke farman baja lane ki aur us ki nafarmaniyon se rukne ki taleem deta rahe. 

Musnad-e-Ahmad mein Rasulullah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ka irshad hai ke jab bachche saat saal ke ho jaen, unhe namaz padhne ko kehte sunte raha karo, jab das saal ke ho jaen aur namaz mein susti karein to unhe maar kar, dhamka kar padhao. Yeh hadith Abu Dawud aur Tirmidhi mein bhi hai. Fuqaha ka farman hai ke isi tarah rozے ki bhi taakid aur tanbih is umr se shuru kar deni chahiye taake baligh hone tak puri tarah namaz-roze ki aadat ho jaye, itaat ke baja lane aur ma'siyat se bachne rehne aur burai se dur rehne ka saliqah paida ho jaye. 

In kamon se tum aur woh jahannam ki aag se bach jaoge jis aag ka indhan insano ke jism aur patthar hain, in cheezon se yeh aag sulgayi gayi hai, phir khayal kar lo ke kis qadar tez hogi? Patthar se murad ya to woh patthar hain jin ki duniya mein parastish hoti rahi jaise aur jagah hai tarjuma: tum aur tumhare mabud jahannam ki lakdiyan ho, ya gandhak ke nihayat hi badbudar patthar hain. 

Ek riwayat mein hai ke Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne is ayat ki tilawat ki, us waqt aap ki khidmat mein ba'z ashab the jin mein se ek shakhs ne daryaft kiya ke ya Rasulullah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) kya jahannam ke patthar duniya ke pattharon jaise hain? Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya haan Allah ki qasam jis ke qabze mein meri jaan hai ke jahannam ka ek patthar sari duniya ke tamam pattharon se bada hai. Unhe yeh sun kar ghashi aa gayi, Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne un ke dil par haath rakha to woh dil dhadak raha tha, aap ne unhe aawaz di ke 'he Shaikh kaho La ilaha illallah', us ne ise padha phir aap ne use jannat ki khushkhabari di. To aap ke ashab ne kaha kya hum sab ke darmiyan sirf isi ko yeh khushkhabari di ja rahi hai? Aap ne farmaya haan dekho Quran mein hai tarjuma: yeh is ke liye hai jo mere samne khada hone aur mere dhamkiyon ka dar rakhta ho. Yeh hadith gharib aur mursal hai.

Phir irshad hota hai is aag se azab karne wale farishte sakht tabiyat wale hain jin ke dilon ke liye kafiryon ke liye Allah ne raham rakha hi nahin aur jo bad-tareen tarkibon mein bari bhari sazayein karte hain jin ke dekhne se bhi patta pani aur kaleja chalni hojaye, Hazrat Ikrimah farmate hain jab dozakhiyon ka pehla jatha jahannam ko chala jaye ga to dekhe ga ke pehle darwaza par chaar lakh farishte azab karne wale tayyar hain jin ke chehre bare haibat-nak aur nihayat siyah hain kuchliyan bahar ko nikli hui hain sakht be-raham hain ek zarre ke barabar bhi Allah ne un ke dilon mein raham nahin rakha is qadar jasim hain ke agar koi parindah un ke ek khoway se ur kar dusre khoway tak pahunchna chahe to kayi mahine guzar jayen, phir darwaza par unees farishte payenge jin ke senon ki chorai sattar saal ki rah hai phir ek darwaza se dusre darwaza ki taraf dhakele jayenge paanch sau saal tak girte rehne ke baad dusra darwaza aaye ga wahan bhi usi tarah aise hi aur utne hi farishton ko maujud payenge usi tarah har ek darwaza par yeh farishte Allah ke farmaan ke tabe hain idhar farmaya gaya idhar unhon ne amal shuru kar diya un ka naam zabaniyah hai Allah hamein apne azab se panah de Ameen. Qayamat ke din kuffaar se farmaya jaye ga ke aaj tum bekaar uzr pesh na karo koi mazrat hamare saamne na chal sakegi, tumhare kartoot ka maza tumhe chakhna hi pare ga. Phir irshad hai ke ae iman walo tum sachi aur khalis tauba karo jis se tumhare agle gunah maaf hojayen mail kuchail dhal jaye, buraiyon ki aadat khatam hojaye, Hazrat Numan bin Basir ne apne ek khutbe mein bayan farmaya ke logo maine Hazrat Umar bin Khattab se suna hai ke khalis tauba yeh hai ke insan gunah ki maafi chahe aur phir us gunah ko na kare aur riwayat mein hai phir us ke karne ka irada bhi na kare, Hazrat Abdullah se bhi usi ke qareeb marwi hai ek marfoo hadis mein bhi yehi aaya hai jo zaeef hai aur theek yehi hai ke woh bhi mauqoof hi hai Wallahu Aalam, Ulama-e-Salaf farmate hain tauba khalis yeh hai ke gunah ko us waqt chor de jo hochuka hai us par nadim ho aur ayindah ke liye na karne ka pukhta azam ho, aur agar gunah mein kisi insan ka haq hai to chauthi shart yeh hai ke woh haq ba-qaida ada kar de, Huzoor ﷺ farmate hain nadim hona bhi tauba karna hai, Hazrat Ubayy bin Ka'ab farmate hain hamein kaha gaya tha ke is ummat ke aakhri log qayamat ke qareeb kya kya kaam karenge ? Un mein ek yeh hai ke insan apni biwi ya laundi ki us ke pakhana ki jagah mein woti karega jo Allah aur us ke Rasool ﷺ ne mutlaq haram kar diya hai aur jis fail par Allah aur us ke Rasool ki narazgi hoti hai, isi tarah mard mard se bad-feqli karenge jo haram aur baais-e-narazgi Allah wa Rasool Allah hai, in logo ki namaz bhi Allah ke haan maqbool nahin jab tak ke yeh tauba nasooh na karein, Hazrat Abu Zar ne Hazrat Ubayy se pucha taubat-un-nasooh kya hai ?

Farmaya maine Huzoor ﷺ se yahi sawal kiya tha toh Aapne farmaya qusoor se gunah ho gaya phir us par nadim hona Allah Ta'ala se maafi chahna aur phir us gunah ki taraf mail na hona, Hazrat Hasan farmate hain Tauba-e-Nasuh yeh hai ki jaise gunah ki mohabbat thi waisa hi bughz dil mein baith jaye aur jab woh gunah yaad aaye us se istighfar ho, jab koi shakhs tauba karne par pukhtagi kar leta hai aur apni tauba par jama rehta hai toh Allah Ta'ala uski tamam agli khataayein mita deta hai jaise ki sahih hadith mein hai ki Islam laane se pehle ki tamam buraaiyaan Islam fana kar deta hai aur tauba se pehle ki tamam khataayein tauba sokht kar deti hain, ab rahi yeh baat ki Tauba-e-Nasuh mein yeh shart bhi hai ki tauba karne wala phir marte dam tak yeh gunah na kare. Jaise ki ahadees-o-asar abhi bayaan hue jin mein hai ki phir kabhi na kare, ya sirf uska azm-e-rasikh kafi hai ki ise ab kabhi na karunga go phir ba-muqtaza-e-bashariyat bhoole chauke ho jaye, jaise ki abhi hadith guzri ki tauba apne se pehle gunahon ko bilkul mita deti hai, toh tanha tauba ke sath hi gunah maaf ho jate hain ya phir marte dam tak us kaam ka na hona gunah ki maafi ki shart ke taur par hai? Pas pehli baat ki daleel toh yeh sahih hadith hai ki jo shakhs Islam mein nekiyan kare woh apni jahiliyat ki buraaiyon par pakda na jayega aur jo Islam la kar bhi buraaiyon mein mubtala rahe woh Islam aur jahiliyat ki dono buraaiyon mein pakda jayega, pas Islam jo ke gunahon ko door karne mein tauba se badh kar hai jab uske baad bhi apni badkirdariyon ki wajah se pehli buraaiyon mein bhi pakd hui toh tauba ke baad bauran aula honi chahiye. Wallahu A'lam. Lafz 'Asa go tamanna umeed aur imkan ke maani deta hai lekin Kalamullah mein iske maani tahqiq ke hote hain pas farman hai ki khalis tauba karne wale qat'an apne gunahon ko maaf karwa lenge aur sarsabz-o-shadap jannaton mein aayenge. Phir irshad hai Qiyamat ke din Allah Ta'ala apne Nabi aur unke imandar sathiyon ko hargiz sharminda na karega, unhe Allah ki taraf se noor ata hoga jo unke aage aage aur daayein taraf hoga. Aur sab andheron mein honge aur yeh roshni mein honge, jaise ki pehle Surah Hadid ki tafsir mein guzar chuka, jab yeh dekhenge ki munafiqon ko jo roshni mili thi ain zaroorat ke waqt woh unse chheen li gayi aur woh andheron mein bhatakte reh gaye toh dua karenge ki اے Allah hamare sath aisa na ho hamari roshni toh aakhir waqt tak hamare sath hi rahe hamara noor-e-iman bujhne na paye.

Banu Kinanah ke ek Sahabi Razi Allahu Anhu farmate hain Fath-e-Makkah wale din Rasoolullah ﷺ ke peeche maine namaz padhi toh maine Aap ﷺ ki is dua ko suna (Tarjuma) Mere Allah mujhe Roz-e-Qayamat ruswa na karna. 

Ek Hadith mein hai Huzoor ﷺ farmate hain Roz-e-Qayamat sab se pehle sajde ki ijazat mujhe di jayegi aur isi tarah sab se pehle sajde se sar uthane ki ijazat bhi mujhi ko marhamat hogi. Main apne samne aur dayen bayen nazrein daal kar apni Ummat ko pehchan loon ga. Ek Sahabi ne kaha Huzoor ﷺ inhein kaise pehchanenge? Wahan toh bahut si Ummatein makhlut hongi. 

Aap ﷺ ne farmaya Meri Ummat ke logon ki ek nishani toh yeh hai ke unke aza-e-wuzu munawwar honge chamak rahe honge kisi aur Ummat mein yeh baat na hogi. Dusri pehchan yeh hai ke unke namah-e-amal unke dayen haath mein honge. Teesri nishani yeh hogi ke sajde ke nishan unki peshaniyon par honge jin se main pehchan loon ga. Chauthi alamat yeh hai ke unka noor unke aage aage hoga.

Tahaffuz-e-Qanoon ke liye Hukum-e-Jihad: Allah Ta'ala apne Nabi ﷺ ko hukum deta hai ke kafiron se jihad kar hathiyaron ke sath aur munafiqon se jihad kar hudood-Allah jari karne ke sath, un par duniya mein sakhti karo, akhirat mein bhi unka thikana jahannam hai jo badtareen baz-gasht hai. Phir misal dekar samjhaya ke kafiron ka musalmanon se milna-julna khalt-malat rehna unhein unke kufr ke bawajood Allah ke haan kuch nafa nahi de sakta. Dekho do paigambaron ki auratein, Hazrat Nuh Alaihis Salam ki aur Hazrat Lut Alaihis Salam ki, jo har waqt un nabiyon ki sohbat mein rehne wali aur din-rat sath uthne-baithne wali aur sath hi khane-peene balke sone-jagne wali thin, lekin chunke iman mein unki sathi na thin aur apne kufr par qaim thin, pas paigambaron ki aath peher ki sohbat unhein kuch kaam na aayi, Anbiya-e-Allah unhein akhrovi nafa na pohncha sake aur na akhrovi nuqsan se bacha sake, balke un auraton ko bhi dozakhiyon ke sath jahannam mein jaane ko keh diya gaya. 

Yeh yaad rahe ke khiyanat karne se murad badkari nahi, Anbiya (Alaihimas Salam) ki hurmat-o-ismat is se bohat aala aur bala hai ke unki gharwaliyan fahisha hon, hum is ka poora bayan Surah An-Nur ki tafsir mein kar chuke hain. Balke yahan murad khiyanat fi-din yaani deen mein apne khawandon ki khiyanat ki aur unka sath na diya. Hazrat Ibn Abbas فرماتے hain ke unki khiyanat zana-kari na thi balke yeh thi ke Hazrat Nuh Alaihis Salam ki biwi toh logon se kaha karti thi ke yeh majnoon hain, aur Lut Alaihis Salam ki biwi jo mehmaan Hazrat Lut ke haan aate toh kafiron ko khabar kar deti thin. Yeh dono bad-deen thin, Nuh Alaihis Salam ki raaz-dari aur poshida taur par iman lane walon ke naam kafiron par zahir kar diya karti thin. Isi tarah Hazrat Lut Alaihis Salam ki biwi bhi apne khawand Allah ke Rasool Alaihis Salam ki mukhalif thin aur jo log aap ke haan mehmaan ban kar theherti yeh ja kar apni kafir kaum ko khabar kar deti jinhein bad-amal ki aadat thi. Balke Hazrat Abdullah bin Abbas R.A se marwi hai ke kisi paigambar ki kisi aurat ne kabhi badkari nahi ki, isi tarah Hazrat Ikrimah, Hazrat Saeed bin Jubair, Hazrat Dahhak waghaira se bhi marwi hai. 

Is se istedlal kar ke baaz ulama ne kaha hai ke woh jo aam logon mein mashhoor hai ke hadith mein hai jo shakhs kisi aise ke sath khaye jo bakhsha huwa ho use bhi bakhsh diya jata hai, yeh hadith bilkul zaeef hai aur haqeeqat bhi yahi hai ke yeh hadith mahz be-asl hai. Haan ek buzurg se marwi hai ke unhon ne khwab mein An-Hazrat ﷺ ki ziyarat ki aur pucha ke kya Huzoor ﷺ ne yeh hadith irshad farmai hai? Aap ne farmaya nahi lekin ab main kehta hoon.

Sa'adat-mand Asiyah (Firaun ki biwi) Yahan Allah Ta'ala Musalmanon ke liye misal bayan farma kar irshad farmata hai ki agar yeh apni zarurat par kafiron se khalt-malat hon toh unhe kuch nuqsan na hoga jaise aur jagah hai tarjum-ul-akh: Imaanwaron ko chahiye ki Musalmano ke siwa auron se dostiyan na karen jo aisa karega woh Allah ki taraf se kisi bhalai mein nahin, haan agar ba-taur bachao aur daf'ah-waqti ke ho toh aur baat hai. Hazrat Qatadah farmate hain ro-e-zamin ke tamam tar logon mein sab se zyada sarkash Firaun tha lekin uske kufr ne bhi uski biwi ko kuch nuqsan na pohanchaya isliye ki woh apne zabardast iman par puri tarah qayam thin aur rahin. Jaan lo ki Allah Ta'ala adil hakim hai woh ek gunah par dusre ko nahi pakadta. 

Hazrat Salman farmate hain Firaun is naik-bakht biwi ko tarah tarah se satata tha, sakht garmiyon mein unhe dhuup mein khada kar deta lekin Parwardigar apne farishton ke paron ka saya un par kar deta aur unhe garmi ki takleef se bacha leta, balki unke jannati makan ko dikha deta jis se unki ruh ki tazagi aur iman ki ziyadati ho jati. Firaun aur Hazrat Musa (Alaihis Salam) ki babat yeh daryaft karti rehti thin ki kaun ghalib raha toh har waqt yahi sunti thin ki Musa ghalib rahe, bas yahi unke iman ka baais bana aur yeh pukar uthin ki main Musa aur Harun (Alaihis Salam) ke Rab par iman layi. 

Firaun ko jab yeh maloom hua toh us ne kaha ki jo badi se badi patthar ki chattaan tumhe mile use uthwa lao, use chat litayo aur use kaho ki apne is aqeedah se baaz aaye, agar baaz aa jaye toh meri biwi hai izzat-o-hurmat ke sath wapas lao aur agar na maane toh woh chattaan us par gira do aur uska qeema qeema kar dalo. Jab yeh log patthar laye, unhe le gaye, litaya aur patthar un par girane ke liye uthaya toh unhone aasman ki taraf nigah uthayi, Parwardigar ne hijab hata diye aur jannat ko aur wahan jo makan un ke liye banaya gaya tha use unhone apni ankhon dekh liya aur usi mein unki ruh parwaaz kar gayi. Jis waqt patthar phenka gaya us waqt un mein ruh thi hi nahi. 

Apni shahadat ke waqt dua mangti hain ki Allah jannat mein apne qareeb ki jagah mujhe inayat farma. Is dua ki is bariki par bhi nigah daliye ki pehle Allah ka pados manga ja raha hai phir ghar ki darkhwast ki ja rahi hai. Is waqyah ke bayan mein marfoo' hadith bhi warid hui hai. Phir dua karti hain ki mujhe Firaun aur uske amal se nijat de, main iski kufr-e-harkaton se bezaar hoon, mujhe is zalim kaum se afiyat mein rakh. In biwi sahibah ka naam Asiyah bint Muzahim tha (R.A). 

Unke iman ka baais bana, woh ek roz Firaun ki ladki ka sar gundh rahi thin, achanak kanghi hath se gir gayi aur unke munh se nikal gaya ki kuffar barbaad hon. Is par Firaun ki ladki ne pucha ki kya mere baap ke siwa tu kisi aur ko apna Rab manti hai?

Us ne kaha mera aur tere baap ka aur har cheez ka Rabb Allah Ta'ala hai, us ne ghussa mein aa kar unhein khoob mara peeta aur apne baap ko is ki khabar di, Firon ne unhein bula kar khud poocha ke kya tum mere siva kisi aur ki ibadat karti ho? Jawab diya ke haan mera aur tera aur tamam makhlooq ka Rabb Allah hai main usi ki ibadat karti hu, Firon ne hukum diya aur unhein maat lata kar un ke haath pairon par meikhein garwa dien aur saanp chhod diye jo unhein kaatte rahein, phir ek din aaya aur kaha ab tere khayaalat durust hue? Wahan se jawab mila ke mera aur tera aur tamam makhlooq ka Rabb Allah hi hai, Firon ne kaha ab tere samne main tere ladke ko tukde tukde kar dunga warna ab bhi mera kaha maan le aur is deen se baaz aa ja, unhon ne jawab diya ke jo kuch tu kar sakta ho kar daal, us zalim ne un ke ladke ko mangwaya aur un ke samne ise maar daala jab us bacha ki rooh nikli toh us ne kaha ae maan khush hoja tere liye Allah Ta'ala ne bade bade sawab tayyar kar rakhe hain aur falan falan naimatein tujhe milengi, unhon ne us rooh farsa sanha ko bachashm-e-khud dekha lekin sabar kiya aur raazi ba qaza ho kar baithi rahein Firon ne unhein phir usi tarah baandh kar dalwa diya aur saanp chhod diye phir ek din aaya aur apni baat dohrai biwi sahibah ne phir nihayat sabar-o-istiqlal se wahi jawab diya us ne phir wahi dhamki di aur un ke doosre bachhe ko bhi un ke samne hi qatal kara diya. Us ki rooh ne bhi usi tarah apni walda ko khushkhabri di aur sabar ki talqeen ki, Firon ki biwi sahibah ne bade bacha ki rooh ki khushkhabri suni thi ab is chhote bachhe ki rooh ki bhi khushkhabri suni aur iman le ayin, udhar un biwi sahibah ki rooh Allah Ta'ala ne qabz kar li aur un ki manzil-o-martaba jo Allah Ta'ala ke haan tha woh hijab hata kar Firon ki biwi ko dikha diya gaya. Yeh apne iman-o-yaqeen mein bohat badh gayin yahan tak ke Firon ko bhi un ke iman ki khabar ho gayi, us ne ek roz apne darbariyon se kaha tumhein kuch meri biwi ki khabar hai? Tum ise kya jaante ho?

Sab ne bari tareef ki aur un ki bhalaiyan bayan keen, Firaun ne kaha tumhein nahi maloom yeh bhi mere siva dusre ko Allah manti hai, phir mashwara huwa ki unhein qatal kar diya jaye, chunache meikhein gaari gayin aur un ke hath paon bandh kar daal diya gaya. Us waqt Hazrat Asiyah ne apne Rabb se dua ki ki Parvardigar mere liye apne paas Jannat mein makan bana, Allah Ta'ala ne un ki dua qabul farmayi aur hijab hata kar unhein un ka Jannati darja dikha diya jis par yeh hansne lagin, thik usi waqt Firaun aagaya aur unhein hansta huva dekh kar kehne laga logo tumhein taajjub nahi maloom hota ki itni sakht saza mein yeh mubtala hai aur phir hans rahi hai yaqinan is ka dimagh thikane nahi, al-gharz unhi azabon mein yeh bhi shaheed huin R.H.

Phir dusri misal Hazrat Maryam bint Imran (Alaihas Salam) ki bayan ki jati hai ki woh nihayat paak-daman thin, hum ne apne farishte Jibrail ki ma'rifat un mein ruh phunki. Hazrat Jibrail ko insani surat mein Allah Ta'ala ne bheja tha aur hukum diya tha ki woh apne munh se un ke kurte ke gareban mein phunk maar dein, usi se haml reh gaya aur Hazrat Isa A.S paida huye, pas farman hai ki main ne is mein apni ruh phunki. Phir Hazrat Maryam ki aur tareef ho rahi hai ki woh apne Rabb ki taqdir aur shariat ko sach manne wali thin aur puri farman-bardar thin.

Musnad Ahmad mein hai An-Hazrat ﷺ ne zameen par char lakeerein khinchin aur Sahaba se daryaft kiya ki jante ho ki yeh kya hai? Unhon ne jawab diya ki Allah Ta'ala aur Us ke Rasul ﷺ hi ko pura ilm hai. Aap ne farmaya suno tamam Jannati auraton mein se afzal Khadijah bint Khuwailid aur Fatimah bint Muhammad aur Maryam bint Imran aur Asiyah bint Muzahim hain jo Firaun ki biwi thin.

Hum ne apni kitab Al-Bidayah wan-Nihayah mein Hazrat Isa A.S ke qisse ke isi Surah ki ayat ke alfaz sayyibatin wa abkaran ki tafsir ke bayan ke moqe par is Hadith ki sanadein aur alfaz bayan kar diye hain. Fa Alhamdulillah.

Aur Allah Ta'ala ke fazl-o-karam se isi Surah ki ayat ke alfaz sayyibatin wa abkaran ki tafsir ke moqe par woh Hadith bhi hum bayan kar chuke hain jis mein hai ki An-Hazrat ﷺ ki Jannati biwiyon mein ek Hazrat Asiyah bint Muzahim R.H bhi hain. Alhamdulillah Surah At-Tahrim ki tafsir khatam huwi.

Allah ke fazl-o-karam aur lutf-o-raham se atthaeeswein pare Qad Sami'Allah ki tafsir bhi khatam huwi, Parvardigar humein apne kalam ki sachi samajh ata farmaye aur amal ki taufiq de. Bari Ta'ala tu ise qabul farma aur mere liye baqiyat-e-salihat mein kar, Amin.

Sa'adat-mand Asiyah (Firaun ki biwi) Yahan Allah Ta'ala Musalmanon ke liye misal bayan farma kar irshad farmata hai ki agar yeh apni zarurat par kafiron se khalt-malat hon toh unhe kuch nuqsan na hoga jaise aur jagah hai tarjum-ul-akh: Imaanwaron ko chahiye ki Musalmano ke siwa auron se dostiyan na karen jo aisa karega woh Allah ki taraf se kisi bhalai mein nahin, haan agar ba-taur bachao aur daf'ah-waqti ke ho toh aur baat hai. Hazrat Qatadah farmate hain ro-e-zamin ke tamam tar logon mein sab se zyada sarkash Firaun tha lekin uske kufr ne bhi uski biwi ko kuch nuqsan na pohanchaya isliye ki woh apne zabardast iman par puri tarah qayam thin aur rahin. Jaan lo ki Allah Ta'ala adil hakim hai woh ek gunah par dusre ko nahi pakadta. 

Hazrat Salman farmate hain Firaun is naik-bakht biwi ko tarah tarah se satata tha, sakht garmiyon mein unhe dhuup mein khada kar deta lekin Parwardigar apne farishton ke paron ka saya un par kar deta aur unhe garmi ki takleef se bacha leta, balki unke jannati makan ko dikha deta jis se unki ruh ki tazagi aur iman ki ziyadati ho jati. Firaun aur Hazrat Musa (Alaihis Salam) ki babat yeh daryaft karti rehti thin ki kaun ghalib raha toh har waqt yahi sunti thin ki Musa ghalib rahe, bas yahi unke iman ka baais bana aur yeh pukar uthin ki main Musa aur Harun (Alaihis Salam) ke Rab par iman layi. 

Firaun ko jab yeh maloom hua toh us ne kaha ki jo badi se badi patthar ki chattaan tumhe mile use uthwa lao, use chat litayo aur use kaho ki apne is aqeedah se baaz aaye, agar baaz aa jaye toh meri biwi hai izzat-o-hurmat ke sath wapas lao aur agar na maane toh woh chattaan us par gira do aur uska qeema qeema kar dalo. Jab yeh log patthar laye, unhe le gaye, litaya aur patthar un par girane ke liye uthaya toh unhone aasman ki taraf nigah uthayi, Parwardigar ne hijab hata diye aur jannat ko aur wahan jo makan un ke liye banaya gaya tha use unhone apni ankhon dekh liya aur usi mein unki ruh parwaaz kar gayi. Jis waqt patthar phenka gaya us waqt un mein ruh thi hi nahi. 

Apni shahadat ke waqt dua mangti hain ki Allah jannat mein apne qareeb ki jagah mujhe inayat farma. Is dua ki is bariki par bhi nigah daliye ki pehle Allah ka pados manga ja raha hai phir ghar ki darkhwast ki ja rahi hai. Is waqyah ke bayan mein marfoo' hadith bhi warid hui hai. Phir dua karti hain ki mujhe Firaun aur uske amal se nijat de, main iski kufr-e-harkaton se bezaar hoon, mujhe is zalim kaum se afiyat mein rakh. In biwi sahibah ka naam Asiyah bint Muzahim tha (R.A). 

Unke iman ka baais bana, woh ek roz Firaun ki ladki ka sar gundh rahi thin, achanak kanghi hath se gir gayi aur unke munh se nikal gaya ki kuffar barbaad hon. Is par Firaun ki ladki ne pucha ki kya mere baap ke siwa tu kisi aur ko apna Rab manti hai?

Us ne kaha mera aur tere baap ka aur har cheez ka Rabb Allah Ta'ala hai, us ne ghussa mein aa kar unhein khoob mara peeta aur apne baap ko is ki khabar di, Firon ne unhein bula kar khud poocha ke kya tum mere siva kisi aur ki ibadat karti ho? Jawab diya ke haan mera aur tera aur tamam makhlooq ka Rabb Allah hai main usi ki ibadat karti hu, Firon ne hukum diya aur unhein maat lata kar un ke haath pairon par meikhein garwa dien aur saanp chhod diye jo unhein kaatte rahein, phir ek din aaya aur kaha ab tere khayaalat durust hue? Wahan se jawab mila ke mera aur tera aur tamam makhlooq ka Rabb Allah hi hai, Firon ne kaha ab tere samne main tere ladke ko tukde tukde kar dunga warna ab bhi mera kaha maan le aur is deen se baaz aa ja, unhon ne jawab diya ke jo kuch tu kar sakta ho kar daal, us zalim ne un ke ladke ko mangwaya aur un ke samne ise maar daala jab us bacha ki rooh nikli toh us ne kaha ae maan khush hoja tere liye Allah Ta'ala ne bade bade sawab tayyar kar rakhe hain aur falan falan naimatein tujhe milengi, unhon ne us rooh farsa sanha ko bachashm-e-khud dekha lekin sabar kiya aur raazi ba qaza ho kar baithi rahein Firon ne unhein phir usi tarah baandh kar dalwa diya aur saanp chhod diye phir ek din aaya aur apni baat dohrai biwi sahibah ne phir nihayat sabar-o-istiqlal se wahi jawab diya us ne phir wahi dhamki di aur un ke doosre bachhe ko bhi un ke samne hi qatal kara diya. Us ki rooh ne bhi usi tarah apni walda ko khushkhabri di aur sabar ki talqeen ki, Firon ki biwi sahibah ne bade bacha ki rooh ki khushkhabri suni thi ab is chhote bachhe ki rooh ki bhi khushkhabri suni aur iman le ayin, udhar un biwi sahibah ki rooh Allah Ta'ala ne qabz kar li aur un ki manzil-o-martaba jo Allah Ta'ala ke haan tha woh hijab hata kar Firon ki biwi ko dikha diya gaya. Yeh apne iman-o-yaqeen mein bohat badh gayin yahan tak ke Firon ko bhi un ke iman ki khabar ho gayi, us ne ek roz apne darbariyon se kaha tumhein kuch meri biwi ki khabar hai? Tum ise kya jaante ho?

Sab ne bari tareef ki aur un ki bhalaiyan bayan keen, Firaun ne kaha tumhein nahi maloom yeh bhi mere siva dusre ko Allah manti hai, phir mashwara huwa ki unhein qatal kar diya jaye, chunache meikhein gaari gayin aur un ke hath paon bandh kar daal diya gaya. Us waqt Hazrat Asiyah ne apne Rabb se dua ki ki Parvardigar mere liye apne paas Jannat mein makan bana, Allah Ta'ala ne un ki dua qabul farmayi aur hijab hata kar unhein un ka Jannati darja dikha diya jis par yeh hansne lagin, thik usi waqt Firaun aagaya aur unhein hansta huva dekh kar kehne laga logo tumhein taajjub nahi maloom hota ki itni sakht saza mein yeh mubtala hai aur phir hans rahi hai yaqinan is ka dimagh thikane nahi, al-gharz unhi azabon mein yeh bhi shaheed huin R.H.

Phir dusri misal Hazrat Maryam bint Imran (Alaihas Salam) ki bayan ki jati hai ki woh nihayat paak-daman thin, hum ne apne farishte Jibrail ki ma'rifat un mein ruh phunki. Hazrat Jibrail ko insani surat mein Allah Ta'ala ne bheja tha aur hukum diya tha ki woh apne munh se un ke kurte ke gareban mein phunk maar dein, usi se haml reh gaya aur Hazrat Isa A.S paida huye, pas farman hai ki main ne is mein apni ruh phunki. Phir Hazrat Maryam ki aur tareef ho rahi hai ki woh apne Rabb ki taqdir aur shariat ko sach manne wali thin aur puri farman-bardar thin.
